# Gayatri College of Nursing, Sundargarh

> Gayatri College of Nursing is a nursing college near NTPC Medical College, Sundargarh, Odisha 770020, India. It offers the 3-year GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery) diploma course. Admission is open for the 2026–27 session. Boys and girls who have passed +2 in any stream can apply.

## Key facts

- Course: GNM (General Nursing and Midwifery), 3 years
- Session: 2026–27, admission open
- Eligibility: +2 pass in any stream (Arts, Commerce or Science) with at least 40% marks for General and 35% for SC/ST
- Age limit: 17 to 40 years
- Who can apply: both boys and girls
- Facilities: hostel, nutritious food, library, Wi-Fi campus
- Address: Near NTPC Medical College, Sundargarh, Odisha 770020, India
- Admission phone: +91 98614 40555 (Surendra Patel), +91 93482 42112
- WhatsApp: +91 98614 40555
- Email: gncsundargarh@gmail.com
- Motto: Learn. Grow. Serve.

## How to apply

1. Call or WhatsApp +91 98614 40555 to check seats and fees.
2. Visit the college near NTPC Medical College, Sundargarh, with your documents.
3. Fill the admission form and confirm your seat.

For fees and seat availability, contact the college by phone. Fees are not published on the website.
